Project: PDF RAG Assistant
Category: Generative AI
Status: featured

Type: RAG-based document question answering application
Description: A Flask-based RAG application that allows users to ask questions about uploaded PDF documents.

Project: PDF RAG Assistant
Category: Generative AI

Technologies:
  - Python
  - Flask
  - Sentence Transformers
  - FAISS
  - Ollama
Features:
  - PDF document upload
  - PDF content extraction
  - Text chunking
  - Sentence Transformer embeddings
  - FAISS-based semantic retrieval
  - LLM-powered question answering using retrieved document context
Technical Workflow:
  - Extract content from uploaded PDF documents.
  - Split the extracted content into chunks.
  - Generate embeddings using Sentence Transformers.
  - Store the embeddings in a FAISS vector index.
  - Retrieve relevant document chunks for a user query.
  - Use an LLM through Ollama to generate an answer from the retrieved context.

Project: PDF RAG Assistant

Role: Designed and developed the RAG pipeline and Flask-based application.
Learning Outcomes:
  - Retrieval-Augmented Generation
  - Semantic search
  - Vector embeddings
  - Vector similarity search
  - LLM integration
  - Document-based question answering
